# 🚀 Release Checklist

- [ ] Reviewed changes and critical open issues
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated
- [ ] Install instructions and dependencies verified
- [ ] CI checks passed
- [ ] Manual smoke test complete
- [ ] Calculation changes independently checked
- [ ] Factor sources, dates, units, boundaries, and licenses reviewed
- [ ] User-facing caveats updated
- [ ] Accessibility reviewed for UI changes
- [ ] No secrets, private data, or generated files included
- [ ] Known issues documented
- [ ] Release notes accurately describe changes
- [ ] Deployment verified from intended commit
